description: 消防現況 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 四日市市. 年度ごとの四日市市消防防災・震災対策に関するデータ. Coverage: 四日市市. The portal files it under the publisher 四日市市. Its tags are 住民向け情報, 救急_消防, 災害. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls. The portal shows 2024-01-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
